text.tspan: LEGEND — a GREEN band marks data with NO message authentication
(no signature/MAC in the RSP layer, so a MITM on L↔S can alter it undetected).
NB: NO field below is application-layer encrypted — confidentiality is TLS-only,
and TLS terminates at the LPA, not the eUICC.
Holds SK.DPauth.ECDSA + CERT.DPauth.ECDSA (issuer = GSMA RSP2 Root CI1)
Phase 1 — ES10b pre-auth material (local APDU, unsigned)
sample N_euicc ∈ {0,1}¹²⁸ (16-byte nonce), retain as anti-replay state
NO AUTH — nonce unsigned on delivery.
Integrity only recovered later IF N_euicc is echoed in the signed serverSigned1.
NO AUTH — unsigned end-to-end. Tamperable CI-list / SVN → bidding-down surface.
NO AUTH — entire request unsigned (eUICC has signed nothing yet).
SAME RESPONSE — fields NOT covered by serverSignature1:
transactionId = TID (top-level JSON copy — canonical copy is inside signed serverSigned1)
euiccCiPKIdToBeUsed = CI1 (04 14 ‖ 160-bit SKI — NOT in serverSigned1, downgrade vector)
Phase 3 — ES10b AuthenticateServer (eUICC evaluates the server)
ctxParams1 = {matchingId, deviceInfo(TAC, capabilities)} — device-asserted, UNAUTHENTICATED input.
eUICC signs OVER it next but never verifies its truth → LPA can spoof TAC / matchingId.
euiccSigned1 = {TID, smdpAddress, N_dp, euiccInfo2, ctxParams1, otPK.EUICC}
[V1 ∧ V2 ∧ V3 = 1 (OBSERVED: ciTrusted = true, stage = accepted)]
Full download continues with ES9+ AuthenticateClient(TID, authenticateServerResponse)

svg.text: error (invalid CI / signature / stale nonce) → CancelSession
